english: This course is hard, but I've learned a lot.

english: The company decided to put me in charge of arranging this meeting.

english: As long as you keep practising every day, your speaking will surely improve.

english: To pass this exam, he studies until very late every day.

english: The work pressure is too great, I want a more relaxed job.
